'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Mike Thomas DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike Thomas]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion / In Complete Control|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Michael Thomas
* '''Deck name:''' First Win in a Decade
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
